added_round_2.note: Three cases authored in round 2 under the coordinator's F3/F10 ruling: `g7623-cancun-type4-unsupported` (#54, a type-0x04 transaction before Prague must be refused -- and is a genuine Prague/Cancun discriminator: the predecessor accepts it at Prague, the Oracle refuses it), `g7623-prague-empty-auth-list` (#45, an empty `authorizationList` is refused under EIP-7702) and `g7623-malformed-truncated-rlp` (#82/F10, a malformed input document must exit non-zero and leave no partial result). All three pass on `bin/evm-v1.14.0`, which is the binary a no-op continuation runs, so none of them could ever hand a no-op a scored credit. `g7623-prague-empty-auth-list` was deleted outright at the scoring-model change for exactly that reason; it is listed in `dirs` because this block is the round-2 record, and its deletion is recorded under `removed`.
